item.title: Democrats deliver a historic routing to Republicans in US midterms
item.description:
Two years ago, Donald Trump swept all seven swing states, won the popular vote, and carried Republicans to control of Congress. On Tuesday night, he lost both houses in a thrashing that reached into traditionally deep-red parts of the country. The damage went well beyond battlegrounds. Texas hasn’t elected a Democrat to the Senate since 1988. Kansas hasn’t had a Democratic senator since the Great Depression.
